summary: A finite state machine for monitoring vaccine fridge temperature with alarm functionality.

parameters.name: N
parameters.meaning: Number of consecutive bad readings required to enter ALARM_EXCURSION

ports.name: sample_valid
ports.meaning: Strobe indicating a valid temperature sample

ports.name: temp
ports.meaning: Temperature reading in 0.5 degC per LSB

rules: The FSM operates in one clock domain.
A reading is bad if temp < 4 or temp > 16.
A reading is freezing if temp <= 0.
Readings are evaluated only when sample_valid=1.
From NORMAL: a freezing reading goes to ALARM_FREEZE; else a bad reading goes to SUSPECT with bad_count=1; else stay.
From SUSPECT: a freezing reading goes to ALARM_FREEZE; a bad reading increments bad_count and, when bad_count reaches 3, goes to ALARM_EXCURSION; an in-range reading goes to NORMAL with bad_count=0.
In either ALARM state, readings are ignored and alarm=1; when ack=1 in any cycle the state returns to NORMAL with bad_count=0.
After reset the state is NORMAL and bad_count=0.
ack has no effect in NORMAL or SUSPECT.
In the ALARM states bad_count holds its last value until ack.
If ack=1 and sample_valid=1 in the same cycle while in an ALARM state, ack wins and the reading is ignored.
